control.$description: Step 6 is the meaningful control boundary; steps 4–5 remain decorative.

interaction.$description: Emphasized edge during pointer hover or drag, independent of keyboard focus.

invalid.$description: Invalid input boundary, independent of error message text.

indicator.$description: Persistent mark for the selected item, independent of keyboard focus.

surface.$description: Subtle background for notices and larger status regions.

compact-surface.$description: Stronger tint for compact status labels, following Geist’s small-element background guidance.
